Game Overview

In Paper Wars Battles and Upgrades, the core idea is straightforward: engage in epic skirmishes drawn on paper. Strategically select your troops, sharpen your aim, and obliterate foes. Battle solo against AI or challenge a friend. Unleash new units and enhance your arsenal for an exhilarating combat experience!
